technical.summary: Overbought short-term technicals (RSI 9 extreme, Stoch 91) conflict with weak intermediate trend structure (below 50/200 MAs, below Ichimoku cloud), creating high pullback risk despite bullish momentum indicators.

sentiment.summary: Extreme fear (VIX-equivalent 12) presents contrarian buy opportunity, but mixed congressional activity (1 sale, 2 small purchases by non-senior members) and absent news sentiment provide no confirmation.

risk.summary: Extreme VIX crisis regime (347.2) with flat yield curve and imminent NFP event create severe macro headwinds; earnings in 63 days poses minimal near-term binary risk but overall environment is highly unfavourable for trading.

debate.key_bull_argument: Extreme RSI overbought (84.65) with Stochastic 91 and supertrend bullish create short-term momentum continuation setup, supported by SMA 9/21 golden cross and contrarian fear-zone opportunity (VIX crisis regime).
debate.key_bear_argument: Price below both 50-SMA and 200-SMA with Ichimoku bearish structure, negative CMF/AO, below-average volume (0.56 ratio), zero fundamental/smart money support, and macro crisis environment (VIX 347.2, flat yield curve, NFP event) create exhaustion risk far outweighing overbought technicals.
